data.one_liner: Library to subscribe and receive push notifications using the UnifiedPush system.
data.what_it_does: It registers the app with a UnifiedPush distributor, receives encrypted push messages and decrypts them automatically, and supports background handling on Linux. It also provides APIs to manage distributors and endpoints.
use_when: You need push notifications without tying to a specific vendor like Firebase
Your app runs on Android and/or Linux and wants to let users choose a distributor
You require automatic decryption of Web Push messages
avoid_when: You only target iOS or web platforms
You prefer a simple local‑notification solution
You don't want to manage an external distributor app
strengths: No vendor lock‑in, works with any UnifiedPush distributor
Handles decryption of Web Push payloads automatically
weaknesses: Requires an external distributor app to be installed
Setup can be complex (native Android config, Linux DBus options)
Limited to Android and Linux; no iOS/web support
data.setup_notes: Add LinuxOptions when initializing, configure Android distributor (or embed one), ensure required permissions, may need dependency_overrides for webcrypto on Linux builds
